name: view_image
description:
Request to view an image file. This tool reads an image file and returns it for visual analysis. Supports common image formats (PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, SVG, WEBP).

Parameters:
- path: (required) Path to the image file (also accepts filePath as alias), relative to the workspace

Example: View an image
{ "path": "assets/screenshot.png" }

filePath.description: Alias for 'path'. Path to the image file, relative to the workspace

path.description: Path to the image file, relative to the workspace
